source: &1404 So, Van der Waal finally agreed to cooperate?
target: &1404 所以，范德瓦尔终于肯配合了？

source: &1030 Yep. Said he could give us a headstart on the Mindjacker.
target: &1030 是啊。他说能帮我们抢在意识劫持者前面。

source: &1405 We'd better not keep the man waiting, then.
target: &1405 那就别让他等太久了。

source: &1031 For such a classy building, they've sure got a lousy old-fashioned elevator.
target: &1031 这么讲究的楼，电梯却又老又破。

source: &1406 I believe the term is 'classic'.
target: &1406 我认为，这应该叫‘经典’。

source: &1032 We're leaving already?
target: &1032 这就走了？

source: &1407 No, not yet.
&1033 Just checking it's still there, then?
target: &1033 那只是确认一下电梯还在？

source: &1408 It's way too big to take with me.
target: &1408 太大了，我可拿不走。

source: &1034 Plus, there's nowhere it'd look good in your apartment.
target: &1034 而且，放你家哪儿都不好看。

source: &1035 You've never struck me as much of an art lover.
target: &1035 我一直没觉得你有多热爱艺术。

source: &1409 I'm not so keen on this kind of thing.
target: &1409 我不怎么喜欢这一类。

source: &1410 The mag-coil keeping it floating, however...
target: &1410 不过，让它悬浮的磁线圈嘛……

source: Picked Up: Mag Coil
target: 已拾取：磁线圈

source: &1411 I don't get the appeal of this...cubist...stuff.
target: &1411 我真不明白这种……立体主义……玩意儿有什么好。

source: &1036 Looks more like abstract impressionism, to me. A classic piece by Chandler, if I'm not mistaken.
target: &1036 我看更像抽象印象派。没认错的话，是钱德勒的一件经典作品。

source: &1412 You know, that's a lot less impressive when you can call up a search inside your head.
target: &1412 你能直接在脑子里搜索，这话听着可就没那么厉害了。

source: &1413 At least it's staying put, now.
target: &1413 至少，现在它老实待着了。

source: &1037 Looks more like abstract impressionism, to me. Dixon's 'Storm', if I'm not mistaken.
target: &1037 我看更像抽象印象派。没认错的话，是迪克森的《风暴》。

source: &1414 We've already gotten in, don't need to ring again.
target: &1414 我们已经进去了，不用再按门铃。

source: &1415 Van der Waal, you there?
target: &1415 范德瓦尔，你在吗？

source: &1416 You sure he's in?
target: &1416 你确定他在家？

source: &1038 He told us to meet him here.
target: &1038 是他让我们来这儿见面的。

source: &1039 Central hasn't logged any departures from this floor since this morning, either.
target: &1039 中枢也没记录到今天早上以来，有谁离开过这一层。

source: &1417 We haven't got time for this, Giel!
target: &1417 吉尔，我们没空等！

source: &1040 I don't think he's answering.
target: &1040 看来他不会应门了。

source: &1418 CEL agents - open the door!
target: &1418 CEL 探员，开门！

source: &1041 We're going to have to try something else.
target: &1041 得换个办法了。

source: &385 While the door has an expensive hardwood appearance, you've no doubt that a man as paranoid as Giel Van der Waal has spared no cost to ensure that it's at least bomb-proof.
target: &385 这扇门看着像是昂贵的实木门。不过，吉尔·范德瓦尔这么多疑，你毫不怀疑他会花大价钱，至少把门做成防爆的。

source: &1419 We're already in, we don't need to bust the lock open.
target: &1419 我们都进去了，不用再撬锁。

source: VDWELLIOTNESS
reason: 内部成就标识；全部脚本引用作为unlockAch参数，沿用原键以保持成就匹配

source: Panel Error[/(Emergency Unlock)/[Consult Maintenance
target: 面板错误[／（紧急解锁）／[请联系维修人员

source: &1042 Whoa-ho, check out Regis, taking the Elliot Ness approach.
target: &1042 哇，看看里吉斯，这是要学埃利奥特·内斯强行破门啊。

source: &1420 We don't have time to hang around outside. I'm just being 'expedient', as Central puts it.
target: &1420 我们没空在外面干等。按中枢的说法，我这叫‘灵活处置’。

source: &1043 Whatever. Van der Waal's not going to be happy about you busting his door.
target: &1043 随你吧。你把门弄坏了，范德瓦尔肯定不高兴。

source: &386 The dock in the wall, where the autonomous vacuum cleaner gets its power and offloads its waste. There is a notice above it:[['The management thanks you for allowing the sanitation machinery and staff to continue their work by not obstructing the docks. These stations are for the use of custodial equipment only.'
target: &386 墙上的停靠充电座，自动吸尘器在这里充电、排出垃圾。上方贴着一则告示：[['感谢各位配合，请勿遮挡停靠座，以便清洁设备与工作人员正常作业。这些停靠座仅供物业清洁设备使用。'

source: &1421 What do you make of this, Max?
target: &1421 麦克斯，你怎么看？

source: &1044 My parents' old bot used to spend much more time in the charger than doing its job.
target: &1044 我爸妈以前那个机器人，待在充电座里的时间，比干活还长。

source: &1045 I kept telling them to get a new one, but they never like to spend until they have to.
target: &1045 我一直劝他们换个新的，可不到非花钱不可，他们就是不肯买。

source: &387 The access pad for the door. If you're not the owner, then this is where you let them know you've arrived.
target: &387 门禁面板。如果你不是屋主，就从这里通知对方你到了。

source: &388 The access pad for the door. It's showing an error message, and indicating the door's unlocked.
target: &388 门禁面板。上面显示着错误信息，并提示门已解锁。

source: &389 After a few moments of contact, the gauge on the side of the cell fills.
target: &389 接触片刻后，电池侧面的电量指示条就充满了。

source: &1422 I'd better not. Might break if it's overcharged.
target: &1422 还是算了。充过头，可能会坏。

source: &1423 That's not going to fit into the charging dock.
target: &1423 这东西放不进充电座。

source: &390 A panoramic 'fish-eye' camera. Probably there so that the Van der Waals can decide whether or not they want to let someone in.
target: &390 全景鱼眼摄像头。大概是让范德瓦尔夫夫看看来的是谁，再决定要不要放人进来。

source: &391 No need, you've already breached the door.
target: &391 没必要，门已经被你打开了。

source: &1424 Hey! Open up! It's Regis!
target: &1424 喂！开门！我是里吉斯！

source: &1425 Nope, that's not going to work.
target: &1425 不行，这样没用。

source: &392 In this part of town, even the buildings look lazy and decadent.
target: &392 在这一带，连楼房都显得慵懒又奢靡。

source: &393 These windows won't open, for insurance reasons.
target: &393 出于保险方面的考虑，这些窗户不能打开。
